assertions: Original defaults/sentinels/value constructors, memberwise copies and borrowed fields preserve position/selection value behavior.
Selection strict interval order, normalization, collapse and range predicates match original headers.

stackDivergence.rationale: Task149 implements original shared EPaM and ESelection public header value contracts: zero defaults, exact signed32 maximal NotFound/All/AtEnd markers, native default/coordinate/position/copy constructors and implicit memberwise assignment, coordinate and endpoint equality, paragraph/index order, adjustedness/value swapping, collapse to either endpoint, HasRange and original diagnostic stream content. Native operator spellings map to equals/lessThan/greaterThan and ostream insertion to toString. Selection order requires adjusted inputs as asserted only in native debug builds: it means strictly disjoint end-before-start intervals, not lexicographic endpoint order; touching or overlapping selections are unordered. Public start/end getters borrow stable mutable position objects; their setters, constructors, Adjust and collapses copy native value fields without introducing JS aliasing. Valid coordinate inputs inhabit signed32 domain; no fabricated clamp/range exception, numeric ABI or native memory handling is introduced. JS GC owns storage. Existing Writer-specific document selection is not duplicated or replaced; these are missing genuine shared EditEngine types for future Calc cell/header-footer text editing. Actual EditTextObject/ScPageHFItem/full pool/model/connected UI/same-model ODS remain pending; localized UI is deferred and no fake text engine is created.
